title: The Kitchen of Bellbird Bay
author: Jude Villalobos
blurb: Dominic Marchetti, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
